hero.title: Mechanical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A **Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** is suitable for students who are interested in designing machines, developing industrial systems, working with vehicles and understanding the working of mechanical equipment. For the 2026–2027 academic year, the University of Mauritius offers a four-year full-time undergraduate program, Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Mechanical Engineering. Students planning to **Study Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius** can explore this undergraduate pathway and its related study options.

faq.question: What is the duration of Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering course in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius will be launching its BEng (Hons) Mechanical Engineering as a four-year full-time program in the academic year 2026-2027.

faq.question: Which is the Mechanical Engineering university in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University Mauritius is a confirmed choice in the official 2026–2027 undergraduate program listings. Students should contact the university directly for current international admission requirements and availability of places.

faq.question: What is the eligibility criteria for the Indian students?
faq.answer: Indian applicants typically need a Class 12 or equivalent qualification with appropriate science and maths subjects. Confirm subject requirements, minimum marks and qualification-equivalence rules with the university.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Tuition fees need to be confirmed with the university. A rough budget would estimate the cost of living to be between MUR 20,500-39,000 per month (approximately ₹38,950-₹74,100) excluding tuition fees and other initial or one-off expenses. These are estimates for planning purposes, not official university rates.

faq.question: What jobs are available after doing Mechanical Engineering?
faq.answer: Graduates can work as mechanical design engineer, manufacturing engineer, maintenance engineer, quality engineer, CAD engineer, project engineer. Career Scope depends on Practical Skills, Experience, Industry Requirements, and Professional Recognition if required.
